output.findings:
The population of Shanghai varies depending on the definition of the city boundaries (administrative vs. metropolitan area) and the methodology used (usual residence vs. urban area estimates). 

Official data for the usual resident population of the Shanghai administrative area was reported at approximately 24.85 million in 2025 by the Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Statistics. 

Alternative estimates that account for the broader metropolitan area, which includes surrounding urbanized regions, often report significantly higher figures, with some sources citing over 30 million people as of 2025.
